rationale:
Positives: The agent verified the user via full name + zip and matched to a single user ID. It collected full address details, executed the default address update correctly, and provided accurate final state when the user decided to keep the new address. When the user asked to revert, the agent requested the full prior address rather than guessing, which is appropriate given the visible tools/results. 

Issues: Policy requires explicitly stating the exact change and obtaining confirmation before any record-changing write (including address updates). The agent proceeded to call modify_user_address after clarifying details, but did not make a separate explicit confirmation request to proceed with the update. Additionally, the policy indicates inspecting user details with read-only tools before committing a change; no such inspection occurred prior to the write. These constitute policy misses, so despite a satisfactory end state, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
